additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0382083-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R6 170002073] Dispenser fuse triggered CRM:01811000360
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
I hope this message finds you well.
We need to conduct a site intervention, first we have to update the firmware of the charger. The current firmware version is 2.11. The update sequence is as follows:
Update from version 2.11 to version 3.08.
Update from version 3.08 to version 4.0.11.
Please ensure that the updates are performed in this specific order.
Before troubleshooting, please ensure whether the fuse FC212 is tripped or not.
It is crucial to inspect the connection to the LEM meter designated for DC3 i.e. BC203.1, as there is a possibility that the fuse may trip due to a faulty LEM meter and also check the feedback line.
If the LEM meter is found to be defective, please replace it promptly. Additionally, ensure that a spare LEM meter is available on-site for any necessary replacements.
If you have any further questions or need additional information, please feel free to reach out.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
